description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Microsoft 365 AI Security Engineer based in United States . 

 The Microsoft 365 AI Security Engineer will design, implement, and optimize enterprise security, compliance, identity, and governance solutions across Microsoft 365 environments. This hands-on consulting role focuses on protecting organizational data, identities, applications, and emerging AI workloads through technologies such as Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and Agent 365. Working across diverse client engagements, the successful candidate will translate complex security and regulatory requirements into practical technical controls and implementation strategies. The role involves close collaboration with client security, compliance, identity, and IT teams, as well as internal architects and consultants. It offers exposure to evolving Microsoft AI security capabilities within a collaborative, global consulting environment. This is a fully remote position in Canada, requiring availability during US time zones.



Accountabilities:
 

 
 Design, configure, implement, and optimize Microsoft Purview security, compliance, information protection, and data governance capabilities.



 
 Configure and manage Purview Information Protection, sensitivity labels, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention policies, eDiscovery, and related compliance controls.



 
 Implement security and governance capabilities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI agents using Agent 365 and associated Microsoft security technologies.



 
 Design and implement identity and access management controls through Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, multi-factor authentication (MFA), role-based access control (RBAC), identity governance, and privileged access management.



 
 Assess existing Microsoft 365 environments, identify security and compliance gaps, and develop actionable recommendations and remediation plans.



 
 Configure and integrate Microsoft Defender and other Microsoft 365 security capabilities across identity, applications, endpoints, and cloud services.



 
 Collaborate directly with client security, compliance, identity, and IT teams to translate business and regulatory requirements into effective technical solutions.



 
 Develop technical documentation, configuration standards, governance frameworks, implementation plans, and operational procedures.



 
 Facilitate client workshops, technical discovery sessions, solution design activities, implementation, testing, and knowledge transfer.



 
 Manage technical work items, delivery documentation, and project status while meeting established quality standards and utilization expectations.




 Requirements:


 
 At least 3 years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Microsoft 365 security, compliance, or identity solutions in enterprise environments.



 
 Strong practical experience with Microsoft Purview, including Information Protection, sensitivity labels, Data Loss Prevention, retention, eDiscovery, and related compliance capabilities.



 
 Experience implementing Microsoft Entra ID security controls, including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, privileged access, and identity governance.



 
 Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, Agent 365, or security and governance controls for enterprise AI workloads.



 
 Experience with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft 365 security technologies, including integration across identities, applications, endpoints, and cloud services.



 
 Understanding of Zero Trust principles and their application across Microsoft 365 identity, data, applications, and collaboration services.



 
 Ability to assess existing technology environments, identify security or compliance gaps, and implement appropriate remediation recommendations.



 
 Proficiency in PowerShell and automation for Microsoft 365 administration, security, compliance, and configuration.



 
 Strong consulting and client-facing capabilities, with the ability to lead technical discussions and communicate recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.



 
 Excellent written communication and documentation skills, with experience working within structured consulting or project delivery teams.



 
 Microsoft security certifications such as SC-100, SC-300, SC-400, or equivalent Microsoft 365 security and compliance credentials are preferred.



 
 Experience securing Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, or other enterprise AI and agent-based solutions is an advantage.



 
 Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud Apps, or broader Microsoft Security technologies is desirable.



 
 Previous experience in consulting, professional services, or complex enterprise Microsoft 365 environments is preferred.



 
 A bachelor's degree in a related technical field or equivalent professional experience is preferred.



 
 Availability to work during US time zones while based remotely in Canada.




 Benefits:


 
 Annual training allowance of $2,000 to support professional development and skills advancement.



 
 Paid time off.



 
 Paid holidays.



 
 Additional employee benefits.



 
 Continuous learning, mentorship, collaboration, and career development opportunities.



 
 A collaborative, people-first work environment where employee contributions and ideas are valued.



 
 Opportunities to work across a diverse global organization and gain experience with modern Microsoft technologies, AI, and enterprise security solutions.



 
 Exposure to a consulting environment with more than 20 years of Microsoft partnership experience and established industry credentials.
